failures.test: AC-13 / FF-T61-12: docker compose up -d --wait fails; choros service never becomes 'healthy'
failures.detail: choros healthcheck in docker-compose.yml uses 'wget' but Dockerfile runtime stage is node:20-slim which has NO wget binary (/bin/sh: 1: wget: not found). The healthcheck always exits 1. Since choros depends_on keycloak+flowable (service_healthy), and KC+flowable healthchecks also fail (pre-existing T-0054/T-0058 bugs), no service downstream of postgres ever becomes healthy via Docker compose --wait. docker compose up -d --wait exits non-zero. The choros healthcheck failure IS a T-0061 product defect (new code); KC/flowable healthcheck failures are pre-existing T-0054/T-0058 bugs.
pre_existing_bugs_noted: KC healthcheck: curl not in quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:25.0.6 image (T-0054 pre-existing; healthcheck authored in T-0054 BUILD bce2ebf)
Flowable healthcheck: --password= is GNU wget syntax but BusyBox 1.36.1 in flowable-rest:7.1.0 does not support it (T-0058 pre-existing; authored in T-0058 BUILD bce2ebf)

failures.test: AC-3 / adversarial probe (a): prod up without .env.prod should fail with required-var error
failures.detail: The spec (AC-3, FR-3) requires compose to 'fail with explicit error variable VAR is not set' when .env.prod is absent. The ${VAR} syntax in docker-compose.prod.yml does NOT cause Docker Compose to fail. Compose emits warnings ('variable POSTGRES_PASSWORD is not set. Defaulting to a blank string.') and exits 0, proceeding to start services with empty passwords. To enforce hard failure, the required form must be ${VAR:?error_message} (compose-spec required syntax). The static grep check (FF-T61-3) only checks for absence of ${VAR:-default}, it does NOT verify the hard-error semantic. The spec's AC-3 claim is NOT fulfilled by ${VAR} syntax.

friction.description: choros healthcheck uses wget but node:20-slim has no wget. Fix: add `RUN apt-get install -y wget` to Dockerfile runtime stage, OR use node-based healthcheck: `CMD-SHELL node -e "require('http').get('http://localhost:${PORT:-3000}/health', r => process.exit(r.statusCode===200?0:1)).on('error',()=>process.exit(1))"`

Required-form protection gap: ${VAR} in docker-compose.prod.yml does not cause Docker Compose to fail when var is unset. Use ${VAR:?error message} syntax to enforce hard failure. E.g. POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:?POSTGRES_PASSWORD required for prod — set in .env.prod}

Pre-existing T-0054: KC healthcheck uses curl which is absent from KC 25 image. Workaround: use wget (which IS in KC image) to hit the management health endpoint. This needs to be fixed in T-0054 scope, not T-0061.

Pre-existing T-0058: Flowable healthcheck uses GNU wget --password= flag which BusyBox wget 1.36.1 doesn't support. Fix: use URL-embedded credentials: wget -q -O /dev/null 'http://admin:${FLOWABLE_REST_APP_ADMIN_PASSWORD:-choros_flowable_dev_pw}@localhost:8080/...'. This needs T-0058 scope fix.

ADR §1.3 silo-upgrade semantics claim that migrations/run.mjs runs at startup when DATABASE_URL is set. This is NOT implemented in current index.ts/server.ts. migrations/ is in the image but is never called at startup. The choros container starts with 'degraded' health because the schema does not exist. This is a seam gap between T-0061 and T-0053.
